name: check_citation
description: Check a quote against its readable original version; for example a table-row citation.

name: compare_versions
description: Compare readable versions by block hash; for example versions one and three.

name: search
description: Find readable source blocks. Use for document questions; for example radiator margin.

name: get_document
description: Read a document outline and versions. Use a known item, such as itm_000000000001.

name: read_chunks
description: Read up to twenty source blocks. Use after search; for example blocks 1 through 3.

name: explore
description: Read blocks around a citation. Use for context; for example two blocks before and after.

name: ask_agent
description: Ask the cited CRAFT runtime; for example a document question from an MCP application.

name: similar_missions
description: Rank readable missions by cited facets; for example design and operations.

name: explain_similarity
description: Read both missions' permitted facet evidence; for example a design comparison.

name: list_missions
description: Resolve readable mission names and aliases. Use before cube reads; for example sim-01.

name: prepare_values
description: Read cited candidates without writing values; for example a mass-budget table.

name: list_parameters
description: Read the parameter dictionary and registered units. Use before filtering, such as kg or g.

name: find_missions
description: Find readable missions matching all conditions. For example dry mass at most 150 kg.

name: get_mission
description: Read accepted mission values on a date. Use a key or alias, for example sim-01.

name: compare_missions
description: Compare two to five readable missions in one scope. For example their mass and power.

name: get_value_evidence
description: Read the cited source row and conversion for a value. Use an accepted value identifier.

name: write_note
description: Keep or replace an owned working note; for example a calculation scratchpad.

name: list_notes
description: List private working-note titles and sizes; use before reading a saved note.

name: read_note
description: Read one owned working note; for example a previously listed scratchpad.

name: delete_note
description: Remove one owned working note; use after its temporary work is complete.
